This season is actually pretty exciting for me, usually I only plan to watch 2, maybe 3 series, while others will be added if the hype surrounding them interests me, but this time around I'm watching at least 6 new shows, should be a fun summer season. Good thing I'm off for the next few weeks to enjoy it all!

Gangsta and Gate have both impressed me so far, though Gangsta has potential to be one of my favorites for the year if it keeps it up.
I guess I'll just say I'm defiantly looking forward to the second season of Non Non Biyori

...senki zesshou SymphoGEAR!!!! There's a new Symphogear this season and I was not informed!!1!!111!!! Based commie pls... YES! Honestly, it's my fault I haven't pay attention to any announcements or season posts besides MonMusu and Aquarion.
I'm definitely watching Non Non Biyori and Yuru Yuri. Other than that i'm also interested in God Eater and Gangsta.

So far I've watched the first episodes of Gangsta, Rokka no Yuusha, and Shimoneta. I'm enjoying all three, not sure about Rokka since the first episode felt a bit rushed, but I do like the story behind it. Gangsta seems like it'll be a great series and Shimoneta is just pants on head retarded!

I'm kinda picky with Anime so I'm a bit surprised I found three shows that piqued my interest.

Just going to go over some of the shows I'm interested in a little bit. If there are any shows like these that haven't hit my radar let me know!

Akagami no Shirayuki-hime - Wasn't keeping an eye on this one, but then I watched the first episode and I was blown away. I've never really watched any shoujo before, so it should be fun.

Bikini Warriors - Even if its bad, I'm going to try to get through this. I tried the same with Triage X and lasted 7 episodes, so we'll see how far we get here.

God Eater - Looking forward to this one! I don't know anything about the source material, but it sounds fun!

Overlord - This sounds like a good wild ride. I can't wait to check it out!

Rokka no Yuusha - I really enjoyed the first episode, and I look forward to seeing more! Good animation, and I love the characters already!

Ushio to Tora - I'm looking forward to this 90s roller coaster ride. The cheese factor is off the charts and that means this show is going to kick some major ass!

Wakako-zake - Salmon skin and sake? I don't know what happened in the first episode really. I'm intrigued.

Working!!! - Well, I've got to catch up on this show before I get here. I'll get there eventually. Its a fun show, but its low on my priority of things to watch. I'm about halfway through the first season for now.

All the anime that I'm watching this summer are based on manga that I've read.
In that vein, I have high hopes for Overlord which only has 7 chapters out, which means they'll probably start making up their own story by the 4th episode.
I also have high hopes for Gate, which has a really dark and pretty gory manga. The anime looks like it's going to be a lot less dark and gory, so it'll be interesting to see how it progresses.

So Gangsta and Gate were pretty good so far. I'm looking forward to Overlord with the hopes that it'll be as good as Log Horizon (or at least better than SAO). And I'm still pretty hype for more Yuru Yuri.
